name: smwsprites-roto-disc-v1
title: Roto Disc V1.1
description:
Description: A circling sprite that flashes different colours and looks like a waffle.

This version includes two .cfg files.

Vanilla - Just use this one if you want a normal roto disc and nothing else

Custom - Use this if you want the new customization options and be able to use the extension field.
Which include:- Adjustable X & Y Radius, Speed, Yoshi Interactions, Spinjumpable options.

You can also turn off the palette rotation and remap tiles accordingly.

Debugging - Tattletale
